intro: I dropped it... The fuel receipt! While I was running from the Admin building earlier!
The digital scan on the office drive is cut off—without that physical paper, the story falls apart!
I have to text Kiko—'Bleachers... basketball court... left it near—'
Battery at one percent?! No, no, no—not now...!
outro: Now you can read the testimony and the proof at the same time.
